label: Yakumo Milk Blossom Semi-Hard

branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

aka: 牛乳の華 セミハード

about.text: A semi-hard cow's-milk cheese from the Yakumo Handmade Association in Hokkaido, sold under the Milk Blossom brand in plain, black pepper, chili and herb versions. It is aged at least 3 months.

sources.text: Brand, varieties, ageing and the association, from this article.
